per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT "T3"."client_id", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, "T3"."birth_date")) FROM "card" AS "T1" JOIN "disp" AS "T2" ON "T1"."disp_id" = "T2"."disp_id" JOIN "client" AS "T3" ON "T2"."client_id" = "T3"."client_id" WHERE "T1"."type" = 'gold' AND "T2"."type" = 'OWNER' LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: For accounts in 1993 with statement issued after transaction, list the account ID, district name and district region.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.account_id, T2.A2, T2.A3 FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.date) = 1993
per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT DISTINCT "a"."account_id", "d"."a2", "d"."a3" FROM "account" AS "a" JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a"."district_id" = "d"."district_id" JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "a"."account_id" = "t"."account_id" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "a"."date") = 1993 AND "a"."date" > "t"."date" LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: From Year 1995 to 2000, who are the accounts holders from 'east Bohemia'. State the account ID the frequency of statement issuance.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.account_id, T1.frequency FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.date) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000
per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT T1."client_id", T2."account_id", T2."frequency" FROM "client" AS T1 JOIN "account" AS T2 ON T1."district_id" = T2."district_id" JOIN "disp" AS T3 ON T1."client_id" = T3."client_id" AND T2."account_id" = T3."account_id" JOIN "district" AS T4 ON T1."district_id" = T4."district_id" WHERE T4."a2" = 'east Bohemia' AND T2."date" BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31' LIMIT 1
